props.name: onRefresh
props.description: Run the refresh. Await it, and the indicator stays until it settles.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Pixels the content must travel before the release counts.

props.name: className
props.description: Height of the scrolling area. It must scroll for the gesture to make sense.

props.name: labels
props.type: { pull?: string; release?: string; refreshing?: string }

props.name: showButton
props.description: Render a real Refresh button above the list. Turn it off at your peril.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.
